name: TextBox 3
text:
CRM Data Failures and Manual Reporting Left Portfolio Decisions Blind
Duplicate records, phantom entries, and manual keying errors in the CRM destroyed trust in lease data and enabled double-counting of active leases.
Leasing managers and directors built their own Excel reports manually, consuming time that should have been spent on strategic portfolio decisions.
Operational and financial data coexisted in the CRM but could not be correlated, hiding the link between maintenance bottlenecks and lease renewal risk.
Absence of real-time insights caused missed renewal windows, delayed vacancy marketing, and extended vacancy durations.

name: TextBox 3
text:
AI, Predictive Models, and Power BI Built on a Validated Lease Data Warehouse
Engineered a data pipeline with strict validation rules to eliminate duplicate and erroneous CRM records, creating a trusted Single Source of Truth for enterprise reporting.
Built interactive Power BI dashboards tracking revenue collection, leasing pipeline status, and occupancy trends, using finalized prior-day data to ensure 100% reporting accuracy.
Deployed an AI-powered conversational agent via Microsoft Teams and M365 Copilot, enabling non-technical users to query lease data in natural language.
Implemented machine learning models delivering 12-month portfolio revenue forecasts and a tenant churn risk score to support proactive retention strategies.

name: TextBox 3
text:
Unified Data Estate Shifts Leasing Teams from Reactive Reporting to Proactive Strategy
Leasing managers now query verified portfolio metrics instantly within Microsoft Teams, eliminating hours of manual report compilation before weekly meetings.
A clean, unified Lease Data Estate ensures the AI Agent and Power BI dashboards always present identical, system-validated figures with no discrepancies.
Leadership can now directly correlate tenant maintenance history with lease renewal probability, enabling intervention before operational issues affect retention.
Machine learning forecasts and churn risk scores allow the leasing team to protect cash flow and optimize occupancy proactively rather than reactively.
